items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So I go up there to work with Nelson Clark

ctx.x: But it couldn't have been too bad. They applauded. [LAUGHS] People were very gracious. They applauded when I got through. So I don't know if it waas good or bad. But anyway, the word got out about the two saxophone players, you know, from Boston, and the word went from one to another.

Well, my stock went right up, because that same day a fellow come and gave me a job working at... A fellow named Clark -- Nelson Clark. He had a job at the Lenox Club, which was...at that time it was Happy Roane's(?) club. Happy Roane had a pretty big-time nightclub. But Happy had been messing with the money, and the club was on the downward trend when I got there. So I go up there to work with Nelson Clark, a little five- or six-piece band....
